Build kit for "time entry detail popover"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
Search matched `product-detail` by name, but the idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: Top Nav
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover. Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        Popover
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      component
score:       104
reason:      matches 1/4 terms: popover
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Popover
description: A click-triggered overlay anchored to a button or trigger element. Use it for secondary actions, inline confirmations, or supplementary information that does not warrant a full dialog. For hover previews use HoverCard, for brief helper text use Tooltip. Under a finger (a coarse primary pointer), it is presented like a native popover: it grows out of its trigger and shrinks back into it on the theme's motion tokens; with reduced motion it cross-fades, opacity only, in 200 ms or less.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component Popover

name:        ComplexSelector
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      component
score:       94
reason:      matches 1/4 terms: popover
import:      @astryxdesign/core/ComplexSelector
description: Use ComplexSelector when a selection needs richer custom content than a Selector option row. It is intentionally one component: ComplexSelector owns the field, trigger, popover, focus restore, and changeAction flow, while the content render prop owns the selector-specific accessible structure.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component ComplexSelector

description: A right-click context menu that appears at the cursor position. Use to provide contextual actions for specific elements or regions without cluttering the UI with visible buttons.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component ContextMenu

name:        DropdownMenu
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      component
score:       94
reason:      matches 1/4 terms: popover
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu
description: A dropdown menu that displays a list of actionable items in a popup triggered by a button. Use to present action options as a next step in a process, or to offer contextual actions without cluttering the interface. Like the menus of macOS and iOS, the row under the pointer when it is released is the row that acts, the highlight follows a held mouse or finger, a mouse opens it on press and can drag straight into it, and a finger held on the trigger opens it with the finger down.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component DropdownMenu

description: HoverCard shows additional information when the user hovers or focuses a trigger element. Use it for profile cards, link summaries, or inline definitions where the user needs more context without navigating away.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component HoverCard

name:        TimeInput

description: TimeInput uses a browser/OS time picker on coarse pointers by default and Astryx's typed field on fine pointers. It converts values to a standard format and supports arrow-key adjustment on the typed surface. Use it in forms, scheduling flows, or any interface where users need to select a specific time.
